about: Tepid Falls street plan after real Waterville (step 1 of tools/briefs/tepid-streets.md). Game metres, north = -z. Traced from OpenStreetMap (Overpass, 2026-11-23, ODbL) and mapped by a thin-plate-spline warp through the anchors below. Polylines are road centrelines. No real names go into the game: real_name is for the lead only.

transform.method: thin-plate spline, smoothing 0.002, no fold (Jacobian > 0 over the whole area)
transform.rotation: none (north stays north; Main St downtown, which runs 12 deg west of north, is straightened onto x 70)

notes: Polylines are drawn from OSM and kept at their real bends; the current engine (plan.ts RoadEdge.horiz, traffic.ts, ground.ts) only knows axis-aligned edges, so step 2 must add angled/curved edges.
Infill zones get small local grids (like the Stacks today) clipped to the arterials; they are not traced street by street.
Main St downtown is straightened onto x 70 (real Main St runs 12 deg west of north); everything else keeps its real shape.
The real Concourse lot is WEST of Main St; the built Holding Pattern is east. Placed list gives both options.
The second Winslow crossing (Carter Memorial Bridge, route 137) falls south of the bluff in the warp and is left out; the Perpetual Bridge from the island takes its place as the southern way in.
